author: Bluegrass Times
title: Five Louisville softball players named to All-ACC teams for 2026 season
text:
The University of Louisville softball team announced on May 6 that five student-athletes have been selected for the All-Atlantic Coast Conference (ACC) teams. Three players—Bri Despines, Chelsea Mack, and Madison Pickens—earned First Team honors, while Camryn Lookadoo and Alyssa Zabala were named to the Third Team.
These selections mark the first time Despines, Mack, Pickens, and Lookadoo have received All-ACC recognition. Zabala was previously named to the Third Team All-ACC and the All-Freshman Team in 2023.
Despines has posted a .404 batting average with 63 hits and 67 runs batted in (RBIs), ranking fourth in the ACC. She also has a .543 on-base percentage and a .731 slugging percentage. Defensively, she has thrown out ten runners attempting to steal bases this season.
Mack leads Louisville at the top of the lineup with an ACC second-best and national fourth-best total of 83 hits while batting .456. She holds a single-season program record with 42 stolen bases. Pickens leads her team in batting average (.468), home runs (9), and slugging percentage (.775). Her RBI total of 69 is third in the league and sets a new single-season record for Louisville.
Lookadoo contributed a .377 batting average with 55 hits and leads both the ACC and ranks sixth nationally with twenty doubles. Zabala made thirty-eight appearances as pitcher—tied for most in the conference—and finished with fourteen wins, four saves, ninety-five strikeouts, two complete games against ACC opponents this season.
The announcement comes as Louisville prepares to compete as No. 5 seed in the opening round of the 2026 Allstate ACC Softball Championship on May 6 against No.12 seed NC State.
